cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I said I'd carry one box. That warehouse isn't the box. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. With one box. We admired how manageable the sentence was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it the biggest one, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. The word 'one' has retained its dignity.

mechanism: A directs a move around the exact promise to carry one box, accepting B bigger choice while narrowing carry to exclude lifting it from the floor.
confusable: Generic refusal lacks a callback to particular agreed words that reduces later obligations.
comparison: Dog alternative narrows duration rather than the physical content of a carrying task.
seedUse: One-box seed supplies the biggest-box counter; S02 keeps B cooperative by accepting that box while directing B to supply the lift.
